text:
ITEM 1: Cubed golden-brown crispy pieces, dry matte surface, browned edges. Likely fried tofu cubes, or roast/fried potato cubes, or fried paneer. Tofu fried: water ~45, protein ~17, fat ~20, carb ~12? Let's choose the most likely: fried potato cubes (roast potatoes) would be water ~50, protein 2, fat 12, carb 30. Fried tofu more likely given crisp-looking cubes and matte sheen. Pick fried tofu: water 45, protein 15, fat 16, carb 6.

ITEM 2: Off-white, opaque, soft chunks and crumbly flakes, moist glossy surface, holds shape. Likely scrambled egg/tofu? Crumbly flakes with smooth rounded chunks suggests cooked fish (cod flakes) or ricotta/paneer. Flaky cooked white fish: water 75? Guidance says meat and fish 55-70. Choose cooked white fish: water 66, protein 22, fat 1, carb 0.

1 | fried tofu cubes | 45 | 15 | 16 | 6
2 | cooked white fish (cod) | 66 | 22 | 1 | 0
